 President of the Hull-Aylmer Federal Liberal Riding Association
 Compliance Order under Section 30
 WHEREAS you are appointed Legislative Assistant in the Office of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance;
WHEREAS pursuant to subsection 28 of the Conflict of Interest Act, I am required to review annually with you, as a reporting public office holder, the information contained in your confidential report and the measures taken to satisfy your obligations under the Act;
WHEREAS an email dated March 25, 2021 was sent to you asking that you return all necessary documents to complete your Annual Review to the Office within 30 days;
WHEREAS despite many reminders, your Annual Review remains outstanding on the day of this Order;
AND WHEREAS pursuant to section 19 of the Conflict of Interest Act, compliance with the Act is a condition of a person's appointment or employment as a public office holder;
I THEREFORE ORDER YOU to submit to my Office, within 10 days of the deemed date of service of this order, all documents identified in the email dated March 25, 2021, all of which are required to complete your Annual Review.
